stem: The table shows the deliveries made by two couriers last week and whether each delivery was on time or late, where \(x\) is a positive integer. If one of the late deliveries is selected at random, the probability that it was made by Courier A is \(\frac{2}{7}\). What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: The late deliveries number \(x + 25\), and \(x\) of them were made by Courier A, so \(\frac{x}{x + 25} = \frac{2}{7}\).
Cross-multiply: \(7x = 2x + 50\), so \(5x = 50\) and \(x = 10\). (The on-time counts are not needed.)
verify:
x = symbols('x', positive=True)
sol = solve(Eq(x / (x + 25), Rational(2, 7)), x)
assert sol == [10]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [10]
